gaps.lead: People thought the species had died out completely.
gaps.explanation: 'People thought it had died out' becomes 'it was thought to have died out'.

gaps.lead: It took the artist three weeks to paint the mural.
gaps.explanation: it took X time to do = X spent time doing: spent over three weeks on.

gaps.lead: They won't allow you to enter without a ticket.
gaps.sentence: You ___ to enter without a ticket.
gaps.explanation: 'They won't allow you' becomes 'you won't be allowed'.

gaps.lead: A professional photographer took the couple's portraits.
gaps.sentence: The couple ___ by a professional photographer.
gaps.explanation: Arranging for a professional to do it: had their portraits taken.

gaps.lead: They say the new tunnel will halve journey times.
gaps.sentence: Journey times ___ by the new tunnel.
gaps.explanation: X is said to be + participle: reported statement, passive meaning.

gaps.lead: Nobody can say that he doesn't work hard.
'Why don't we hold the wedding outdoors?' said Ana.
gaps.explanation: suggest + that-clause, or suggest + -ing: suggested they hold / suggested holding.

gaps.lead: I'm sure Jemma is going to become a famous model one day.
gaps.sentence: I think it's only ___ Jemma becomes a famous model.
gaps.explanation: 'It's only a matter of time before' means it will definitely happen eventually.
